title: NFT SVG Designer
tagline: Tools for building interactive NFTs, including a deployed library and two smart contracts.
description: Written in Solidity, deployed on mumbai and polygon, aims to provide useful libs and tool for generating SVG, according to the Don't Repeat Yourself approach. A SVG toolbox helping to deploy advanced NFT embedding SVG, and several nice NFTs, mintable and displayed in our gallery.
how_its_made:
A (huge) library containing several SVG primitives is deployed once, then we build on top widgets libraries and smart contract linked to it.

As most of the SVG attributes are encoded in bytes array to save space, tools will be released to help the user to build on those libs. Written in Solidity, deployed on mumbai and polygon, aims to provide useful libs and tool for generating SVG, according to the Don't Repeat Yourself approach.
